title: Adaptive throughput watermark sentinel for private-edge workers
creator: Ava Chen
description: Introduce an adaptive throughput watermark sentinel and saturation-aware health checks for Private (VPC) edge workers. The sentinel will detect under-provisioning and imminent saturation by combining token-throughput watermarks, request queue depth, and GPU/NIC utilization. It will emit distinct health events (OK / Degraded / Saturated) consumed by the control plane routing layer and alerting. The work includes Terraform/IaC hooks to configure per-deployment thresholds, Grafana dashboards, alert rules, a synthetic traffic generator for verification, and runbook updates.
acceptance_criteria: Sentinel exposes a new metric series 'vpc.edge.throughput_watermark' with values: low, nominal, high, saturated
Routing layer receives health events and can mark a worker as 'soft-degraded' (reduce new assignments) and 'hard-saturated' (drain) within configured TTLs
Terraform module additions allow per-deployment overrides for low/high watermark token rates and saturation windows
Alerting rules fire for >3m sustained 'saturated' state and severity escalates to paging for high-impact customers
Automated smoke test (synthetic generator) reproduces saturation conditions in a canary environment and validates health transitions
Documentation and runbook published with exact debug steps and rollback instructions
tasks: Design spec: watermark algorithm and signals (latency percentiles, token/sec, queue depth, GPU util)
Implement sentinel in edge-worker process: sample token throughput per tenant and global, compute EWMA, map to watermark buckets
Add saturation probe (local readiness) that considers kernel queue depth and token backlog
Instrument metrics export (Prometheus) and add labels: deployment_id, zone, tenant_tier
Terraform: extend modules/private-edge with 'watermark_config' block and default sane thresholds
Create Grafana dashboards and alerting rules in monitoring repo
Build synthetic traffic generator and integration tests in infra-ci
Write runbook and update console UI mapping for health states

test_plan: Create a canary environment using existing private-deploy test harness. Run synthetic generator to drive token/sec from nominal to saturated range and observe metric transitions. Validate routing layer decision: when 'soft-degraded' is emitted, new request distribution reduces by >=50% within 30s. Validate 'hard-saturated' triggers drain and no new active assignments for 5m. Record traces and token latency percentiles for each state.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature-flagged rollout to canary pool (10 workers) using terraform: apply watermark_config defaults. 2) Monitor metrics + alerts for 48h. 3) Gradual ramp to 20% of clusters, validate with synthetic runs. 4) Full rollout with migration window and emergency rollback toggle to disable sentinel and revert to previous health checks. Notify SRE and support N teams during rollout.
notes: Trade-offs: we chose EWMA for throughput smoothing to minimize reaction to transient spikes; window tuning will be primary lever. We intentionally separate 'soft-degraded' from 'hard-saturated' so that the control plane can take graceful measures (reduce assignments) before draining. Blockers: race conditions during worker drain, and finalizing tenant_tier mapping for multi-tenant token budgets. Security: sentinel emits only aggregated metrics (no PII).
